car.name: 2005 Ford GT (8.4L V10 engine swap)
car.note: Confirmed V10 via telemetry cylinder count (cyl=10). Stock car is a 5.4L supercharged V8.

engine.fuel_ignition_displacement_intercooler_o: marked installed in OCR, individual tiers not cleanly read (likely mostly stock; PI spent on the swap, not internals)

drivetrain.transmission: Stock (final-drive tuning only; individual gear ratios LOCKED)
drivetrain.differential: Race Diff (full accel/decel lock tuning unlocked)

aero.rear_wing: Race adjustable rear wing (adjustable rear downforce)

tires.note: Front width is MAXED - no wider front tire option available for this car.

powertrain.shift_point_note: Shift near 8000 (just before limiter), not at peak power; powerband is 5441-8000 rpm.

performance_readout.note: Tune-screen panel read at camber -1.8 state; telemetry top speed from GTGolitah3/5 full laps.

telemetry_baseline.note: Front axle grip-saturated at apex (combined slip >= 1.0). Front ARB change (34->28) was a null result; front camber optimum is ~-1.8 (-2.2 and -2.3 both worse on balance). Slow-corner understeer is build-limited (front width maxed, heavy rear-biased V10), but did NOT prevent the best lap - Goliath time lives in fast corners.

pending_recommendations: Caster 6.0 -> 6.5: adds cornering front grip via dynamic camber without the braking-lockup penalty of static camber (the right lever now that camber/width are maxed).
Camber -2.2 -> -2.0 and front downforce 330 -> 320: consistency fixes, recover braking stability and calm the new 92 mph high-speed oversteer snap; keep if lap time holds.
Hold V10 vs revert to V8: V10 = +11 mph top speed but more understeer + lazier turn-in; V8 = lighter, more front-balanced. Decide on timed laps.
data_caveats: FH6 tire temperature is NOT a verified grip signal (project memory refutes temp-zone=peak-grip); tune by grip/slip, not temp.
Goliath gives no clean lap splits in telemetry (laps_seen [0,0]); judge pace by in-game lap time, balance by phase-conditioned numbers.
Some build part tiers (engine internals, clutch, driveline) were marked installed but not cleanly OCR-read.

Tune values reconciled to fh6-claude live capture (14:48): springs were reset by the engine swap (was 561/824 V8-era assumption, now 551.5/509.7 front-stiffer-than-rear); caster now 7.0 (ABOVE verified 5.5-6.5 band); front DF pulled to 320 per rec, rear DF 530; final drive reads 4.20 here vs an earlier 4.80 OCR - unconfirmed which. Gearing verdict (power/drag-limited) is telemetry-based, unaffected.
